newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market very slow at $66-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market very slow at $66-USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test, USDA said. Inquiry was good and demand moderate. Sales confirmed on 1,200 slaughter steers and 900 slaughter heifers Thursday.
For the week to date 24300 head confirmed, mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225 lbs 66.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025 lbs 66.00.
